(Grand Rapids, Michigan) | college = [[Michigan Wolverines men's basketball|Michigan]] (2021–present) | highlights = * Third-team All-[[Big Ten Conference|Big Ten]] ([[2022–23 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|2023]]) * [[McDonald's All-American Game|McDonald's All-American]] ([[2021 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2021]]) * [[Jordan Brand Classic]] (2021) | medal_templates = }} '''Kobe Bufkin''' (born September 21, 2003) is an American [[college basketball]] player for the [[Michigan Wolverines men's basketball|Michigan Wolverines]] of the [[Big Ten Conference]]. ==High school career== Bufkin played basketball for [[Grand Rapids Christian High School]] in [[Grand Rapids, Michigan]].{{cite web |last1=Lacett |first1=Mike |title=Grand Rapids Christian star hoping to be the next famous Kobe |url=https://www.wzzm13.com/article/sports/high-school/hs-basketball/grand-rapids-christian-star-hoping-to-be-the-next-famous-kobe/69-d8fab43f-3b7a-48cb-be8d-ae64b3c6b196 |website=[[WZZM]] |access-date=August 12, 2021 |date=January 21, 2020}}{{cite web |last1=DeCamp |first1=Scott |title=Michigan State recruiting target Kobe Bufkin puts game on full display |url=https://www.mlive.com/highschoolsports/2019/12/michigan-state-recruiting-target-kobe-bufkin-puts-game-on-full-display.html |website=MLive |access-date=August 12, 2021 |date=December 28, 2019}} He joined the [[varsity team]] as a freshman.{{cite web |last1=Raffel |first1=John |title=Grand Rapids Christian sophomore Kobe Bufkin gaining notice for his all-around play |url=https://www.mlive.com/community/2018/12/grand-rapids-christian-sophomore-kobe-bufkin-gaining-notice-for-his-all-around-play.html |website=MLive |access-date=August 12, 2021 |date=December 21, 2018}} As a sophomore, Bufkin averaged 20 points, seven rebounds and three assists per game, helping his team achieve a 16–6 record. In his junior season, he averaged 22 points, five rebounds and four assists per game, leading his team to a 20–2 record.{{cite web |last1=Kahn |first1=Andrew |title=Kobe Bufkin, guard from Grand Rapids, commits to Michigan basketball |url=https://www.mlive.com/wolverines/2020/07/kobe-bufkin-guard-from-grand-rapids-commits-to-michigan-basketball.html |website=MLive |access-date=August 12, 2021 |date=July 10, 2020}} As a senior, he averaged 25 points, seven rebounds and five assists per game in five games, before missing most of the season with a fractured left wrist.{{cite web |last1=Spencer |first1=Jamal |title=Bufkin hopes to return to the court during the playoffs |url=https://www.wzzm13.com/article/sports/bufkin-hopes-to-return-to-the-court-during-the-playoffs/69-3ee63f4f-196f-46c8-ad23-5d70005dc91a |website=[[WZZM]] |access-date=August 12, 2021 |date=March 18, 2021}} Bufkin was named to the [[2021 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|McDonald's All-American Game]] and [[Jordan Brand Classic]] rosters.{{cite web |last1=Wells |first1=Seth |title=GR Christian’s Kobe Bufkin named a McDonald’s All-American |url=https://www.woodtv.com/sports/high-school-preps/gr-christians-kobe-bufkin-named-a-mcdonalds-all-american/ |website=[[WOOD-TV]] |access-date=August 12, 2021 |date=February 23, 2021}} ===Recruiting=== A consensus four-star [[college recruiting|recruit]], Bufkin committed to playing college basketball for [[Michigan Wolverines men's basketball|Michigan]] over offers from [[LSU Tigers men's basketball|LSU]], [[DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball|DePaul]], [[Michigan State Spartans men's basketball|Michigan State]] and [[Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball|Ohio State]].{{cite web |last1=Hawkins |first1=James |title='Really good upside': Grand Rapids standout Kobe Bufkin commits to Michigan's 2021 class |url=https://www.detroitnews.com/story/sports/college/university-michigan/wolverines/2020/07/10/grand-rapids-standout-kobe-bufkin-commits-michigan-wolverines-2021-class/5413038002/ |website=[[The Detroit News]] |access-date=August 12, 2021 |date=July 10, 2020}} He was drawn to Michigan by assistant coach [[Saddi Washington]].{{cite web |last1=Sang |first1=Orion |title=How did Michigan basketball land Kobe Bufkin? John Beilein holdover had a big hand in it |url=https://www.freep.com/story/sports/college/university-michigan/wolverines/2020/07/12/michigan-basketball-recruiting-kobe-bufkin-saddi-washington/5411934002/ |website=[[Detroit Free Press]] |access-date=August 12, 2021 |date=July 12, 2020}} Along with [[Caleb Houstan]], [[Moussa Diabaté]], he was part of a recruiting class that was the top-ranked class in the nation for the [[2021–22 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team|2021–22 Michigan Wolverines]].{{cite web|url=https://www.freep.com/story/sports/college/university-michigan/wolverines/2020/11/11/michigan-basketball-2021-recruiting-class-juwan-howard-wolverines/6252919002/ |title=Meet Juwan Howard's ==College career== As a freshman, Bufkin averaged three points and 1.1 rebounds per game in 10.6 minutes per game.{{cite web |last1=Zuniga |first1=Alejandro |title=Teammates reveal the most impressive player on the Michigan men’s basketball team |url=https://247sports.com/college/michigan/Article/Michigan-basketball-Kobe-Bufkin-most-impressive-player-Wolverines-2022-23-195815328/ |website=247 Sports |access-date=October 31, 2022 |date=October 20, 2022}} On December 20, 2021, he earned co-Big Ten freshman of the week honors for his first double digit scoring effort on December 18 against [[2021–22 Southern Utah Thunderbirds men's basketball team|Southern Utah]].{{Cite web|title=Iowa, Michigan and Nebraska Receive Weekly Men’s Basketball Awards|url=http://bigten.org/news/2021/12/20/iowa-michigan-and-nebraska-receive-weekly-mens-basketball-awards.aspx|access-date=2021-12-21|website=bigten.org}}{{cite web|url=http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401372136|title=Dickinson double-double paces Michigan's 87-50 romp|access-date=December 18, 2021|date=December 18, 2021|publisher=[[ESPN]]|agency=[[Associated Press]]}}{{cite web|url=https://mgoblue.com/news/2021/12/18/mens-basketball-first-half-runs-pace-michigan-in-win-over-southern-utah.aspx|title=First-Half Runs Pace Michigan in Win Over Southern Utah|first=Tom|last=Wywrot|access-date=December 18, 2021|date=December 18, 2021|publisher=[[CBS Interactive]]|website=MGoBlue.com}} He picked up a lot of minutes as a sophomore following the [[2022–23_Michigan_Wolverines_men%27s_basketball_team#Departures|2022 departures]] of [[Eli Brooks]], [[DeVante' Jones]] and Frankie Collins. He posted a then-career-high 22 points in back-to-back games against [[2022–23 Lipscomb Bisons men's basketball team|Lipscomb]] (December 17){{cite web|url=https://mgoblue.com/news/2022/12/17/mens-basketball-michigan-survives-late-scare-from-lipscomb-behind-bufkins-career-high-22-points.aspx|title=Michigan Survives Late Scare from Lipscomb Behind Bufkin's Career-High 22 Points|first=Tom|last=Wywrot|date=December 17, 2022|access-date=December 17, 2022|publisher=[[CBS Interactive]]|website=MGoBlue.com}} and [[2022–23 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]] in the [[Jumpman Invitational]] (December 21).{{cite web|url=https://mgoblue.com/news/2022/12/21/mens-basketball-michigan-drops-jumpman-invitational-matchup-against-north-carolina.aspx|title=Michigan Drops Jumpman Invitational Matchup Against North Carolina|first=Tom|last=Wywrot|date=December 21, 2022|access-date=December 21, 2022|publisher=[[CBS Interactive]]|website=MGoBlue.com}} On February 2, 2023, Bufkin contributed 15 points and a career-high 12 rebounds, for his first career double-double as well as a career-high eight assists against [[2022–23 Northwestern Wildcats men's basketball team|Northwestern]].{{cite web|url=https://mgoblue.com/news/2023/2/2/mens-basketball-bufkin-notches-first-career-double-double-in-win-at-northwestern.aspx|title=Bufkin Notches First Career Double-Double in Win at Northwestern|first=Tom|last=Wywrot|date=February 2, 2023|access-date=February 2, 2023|publisher=[[CBS Interactive]]|website=MGoBlue.com}} On February 26, Bufkin led Michigan with a career-high 28 points in an 87–79 overtime victory over [[2022–23 Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball team|Wisconsin]].{{cite web|url=https://mgoblue.com/news/2023/2/26/mens-basketball-dickinsons-buzzer-beater-forces-ot-in-u-m-win-over-wisconsin.aspx|title=Dickinson's Buzzer-Beater Forces OT in U-M Win Over 2023|publisher=[[ESPN]]|agency=[[Associated Press]]}} Following the regular season, he earned All-Big Ten 3rd team recognition from the media and honorable mention recognition from the coaches.{{cite web|url=https://mgoblue.com/news/2023/3/7/mens-basketball-dickinson-bufkin-howard-earn-big-ten-postseason-honors.aspx|title=Dickinson, Bufkin, Howard Earn Big Ten Postseason
